segments.an6.21:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati sāmagāmake pokkharaṇiyāyaṃ.
segments.an6.21:1.2: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇiyaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.21:2.3: Kammārāmatā, bhassārāmatā, niddārāmatā – ime kho, bhante, tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantī”ti.
segments.an6.21:2.7: Atha kho sā devatā “samanuñño me satthā”ti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
segments.an6.21:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an6.21:3.2: “imaṃ, bhikkhave, rattiṃ aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇiyaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho, bhikkhave, sā devatā maṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.21:3.5: Kammārāmatā, bhassārāmatā, niddārāmatā – ime kho, bhante, tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantī’ti.
segments.an6.21:3.8: Idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
segments.an6.21:3.9: Tesaṃ vo [kho (ka.)], bhikkhave, alābhā tesaṃ dulladdhaṃ, ye vo devatāpi jānanti kusalehi dhammehi parihāyamāne”.
segments.an6.21:4.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an6.21:4.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.an6.21:4.6: Saṅgaṇikārāmatā, dovacassatā, pāpamittatā – ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo parihāniyā dhammā”.
segments.an6.21:5.1: “Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, atītamaddhānaṃ parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi, sabbete imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi.
segments.an6.21:5.2: Yepi hi keci, bhikkhave, anāgatamaddhānaṃ parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi, sabbete imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi.
segments.an6.21:5.3: Yepi hi keci, bhikkhave, etarahi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehi, sabbete imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehī”ti.

lines: 21-22. Tatiyassa paṭhame sāmagāmaketi sāmakānaṃ ussannattā evaṃladdhanāme gāmake.
Abhikkantāya rattiyāti rattiyā paṭhamayāmaṃ atikkamma majjhimayāme sampatte.
Pokkharaṇiyaṃ obhāsetvāti pokkharaṇiyānāmakaṃ mahāvihāraṃ attano obhāsena pharitvā.
Anavasesaṃ pharituṃ samatthassapi obhāsassa kenaci kāraṇena ekadesapharaṇampi siyā, ayaṃ pana sabbasova pharatīti dassetuṃ samantattho kappa-saddo gahito.
Attano obhāsena pharitvāti vatthālaṅkārasarīrasamuṭṭhitena obhāsena pharitvā, candimā viya ekobhāsaṃ ekapajjotaṃ karitvāti attho.
Dukkhaṃ vaco etasminti dubbaco, tassa kammaṃ dovacassaṃ, tassa puggalassa anādariyavasena pavattā cetanā, tassa bhāvo atthitā dovacassatā.
Catunnaṃ vā khandhānaṃ apadakkhiṇaggāhitākārena pavattānaṃ etaṃ adhivacananti vadanti.
Pāpā assaddhādayo puggalā etassa mittāti pāpamitto, tassa bhāvo pāpamittatā.
Yāya hi cetanāya puggalo pāpamitto pāpasampavaṅko nāma hoti, sā cetanā pāpamittatā.
Cattāropi vā arūpino khandhā tadākārappavattā pāpamittatā.
